reason: I don't want another monthly subscription, even at 99 baht, when Thai YouTube and TikTok teach tom yum and green curry for free and I can just ask my mom on LINE. Maybe I'd try the two free dishes, but in my little kitchen corner, cooking curry just for me often costs more than a 50-baht bag from the market downstairs.
objection: It's a bill that renews by itself every month. I'm scared I'd forget to cancel after the free month and keep paying for an app I only open once or twice a week.
would_change_my_mind: Let me pay once, like 99 baht to keep the 12 dishes, with no monthly renewal.
